title: Approval Gate: SSO, RBAC, Audit & Keying Requirements — PRD Clarifications and Acceptance Criteria
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: This ticket captures final clarifications to the PRD for SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit logging, and KMS/HSM integration for Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments and defines the acceptance criteria and approval checklist required for sign-off before Beta rollout.

Context: Several PM and engineering reviews uncovered ambiguous edge cases around cross-tenant SAML mappings, delegated admin roles, and key rotation responsibilities when customers use their own HSM. This ticket consolidates clarified requirements, trade-offs, and concrete test evidence expected for each compliance gate.
scope:
In scope:
- SSO/SAML: metadata ingestion, IdP certificate rotation, certificate expiry alerts, SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows, group/attribute mapping guidance.
- RBAC: role model for org-admin, tenant-admin, service-account, read-only auditor; API surface for role bindings; enforcement at control plane and node agent.
- Audit logs: schema, retention options, tamper-evidence, export to customer SIEM (syslog/S3).
- KMS/HSM: CMEK integration for control plane secrets, instructions for HSM-backed key import, documented emergency key-rotation playbook.

Out of scope:
- Customer-managed PKI issuance workflows (will be covered by separate infra project).
- Third-party SSO adapters beyond SAML and OIDC (future work).
clarifications:
Open questions addressed in this ticket:
1) Does RBAC need resource-scoped roles per-tenant? -> Yes; design requires tenant-scoped role bindings by default with option for org-wide roles for enterprises.
2) Who triggers HSM key rotation? -> Customer controls HSM rotation; Redwood must support key rollover and preserve access to historical audit logs; documented rollback steps required.
3) What qualifies as tamper-evidence for audit logs? -> Signed log blobs with sequence numbers and optional append-only ledger metadata; must be sufficient for auditor to prove completeness for a quarter.

Notes: PM/Legal clarified that customer-provided HSMs must meet FIPS 140-2 Level 3 for production sign-off in regulated verticals.
acceptance_criteria:
SSO/SAML:
- [ ] SP metadata import works with IdP metadata XML via console and CLI.
- [ ] Certificate rotation workflow documented and automated where possible (notify at 30/14/7 days).
- [ ] Group/attribute mappings available and honored in token issued to Redwood control plane.

RBAC:
- [ ] Roles: org-admin, tenant-admin, developer, auditor, service-account exist and are enforceable via API.
- [ ] Role binding API validated with unit/integration tests and documented examples.
- [ ] Delegated admin flows tested across two tenants in staging.

Audit Logging:
- [ ] All authz/authn events and key lifecycle events emitted to audit stream.
- [ ] Logs can be exported to syslog and S3 with retention policy configuration.
- [ ] Tamper-evidence proof generated for a 30-day window and validated by internal security team.

KMS/HSM:
- [ ] CMEK integration end-to-end documented for control plane secrets.
- [ ] HSM import and key-wrap test performed in staging with customer-simulated HSM.
- [ ] Key rotation playbook produced and tested for rollback.

Cross-cutting:
- [ ] End-to-end test runbook that demonstrates SSO login, role binding, a privileged action, audit export, and key rotation recorded and stored in QA artifacts.
- [ ] Legal and Compliance have reviewed artifacts and provided sign-off comments.
- [ ] All criteria above have traceable verification links to test runs or PRs.
signoff_checklist:
SSO / SAML:
- [ ] IdP metadata import: PR in repo: PR#3421; test matrix attached (PASS/FAIL).
- [ ] Certificate rotation notifications configured with email + webhook.
- [ ] Console UI components for SSO config reviewed by Design (link to Figma).

RBAC:
- [ ] API contract: openapi/rbac.yaml PR#3567 merged.
- [ ] Migration plan for existing role model (compatibility notes included).
- [ ] Load test demonstrating policy eval latency < 5ms p95 under expected load.

Audit Logs:
- [ ] Schema v1 published and registered in internal catalog.
- [ ] Export connectors for syslog and S3 validated (integration test IDs listed).
- [ ] Proof of tamper-evidence generation: internal security report attached.

KMS / HSM:
- [ ] CMEK documentation for customers: Confluence doc ready.
- [ ] HSM import tool validated with simulated HSM device.
- [ ] Key rotation playbook reviewed by Infra and Support.

Compliance Evidence:
- [ ] Legal sign-off: acceptance comments included.
- [ ] Compliance checklist items traceable to artifacts in the release folder.

Gating for Beta Rollout:
- [ ] All required items above have 'Approved' by respective owners.
- [ ] Security must run a final checklist-run and mark ticket 'Security Verified'.
decisions:
- We will support both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated SAML flows at Beta, OIDC deferred to follow-up.
- RBAC enforcement will be implemented at control plane and at node-agent for sensitive operations; node-agent enforcement will be feature-flagged during rollout.
- For tamper-evidence we will ship signed log blobs initially and evaluate append-only ledger (e.g., Merkle) in a follow-up if auditors request cryptographic proofs.
- Customer-provided HSMs are supported but must meet minimum compliance (FIPS 140-2 L3); Redwood will also provide a managed HSM option where customers do not have one.
open_risks:
- Delay in ENG-4120 (node-agent RBAC enforcement) will push full rollout beyond Beta and require fallback plan.
- Some large customers requested SAML multi-tenant mapping patterns that are not covered by the initial mapping UI; additional PM work needed.
- Evidence requirements from 3rd-party auditors may increase scope for tamper-evidence implementation.
- Support runbook clarity: first contact support engineers may need extra training for HSM incidents.
